sources.publisher: Ripple — DriveWealth partnership for institutional digital-asset infrastructure
claims: DriveWealth is integrating Ripple stablecoin infrastructure to support settlement in Europe using RLUSD on XRPL and Ripple Mint burn/mint capabilities, with plans to expand to the United States.
DriveWealth is integrating Ripple Payments for cross-border acceptance from global partners.
DriveWealth is working with Ripple on digital-asset custody in Europe, with plans to expand to additional markets.
DriveWealth and Ripple Prime are exploring equity financing opportunities through Ripple Prime Delta One.
DriveWealth states clients can fund and manage collateral accounts with stablecoins that convert to cash near real time.
DriveWealth says it powers investing experiences for more than 100 partners globally.
limitations: The release says the companies are integrating and working on these capabilities; production launch and live transaction volume were not verified.
No RLUSD settlement volume, collateral balances, XRP holdings, XRP purchases or XRP bridge volume are disclosed.
Stablecoin funding of brokerage collateral accounts does not establish that native XRP is accepted as collateral.
DriveWealth's 100-plus partner network is distribution reach, not proof that all partners adopt Ripple or RLUSD.
